thread.document:
I used Qwen3-Max to solve the math problems on HW02 (Problems 1, 2, and 5). Qwen3-Max was able to correctly one-shot all three math question on this homework. 

At first, I provided just the homework pdf without the stated correction; this caused the model to have significantly more trouble with problem 1(b), but after providing the correction it was able to solve the problem clearly. 

Additionally, there was only one minor hallucination, related to the "Important Note" that it provides in its solution to Problem 1 (b); which did not affect its ability to correctly answer the question.

An annotated copy of the conversation (formatted in Latex) can be found here.
